what: Settling and block-length dependence in the existing 1020-cycle unmodified-engine 2D baselines (E0020, E0024), L = 400 and L = 100. No new runs. Per-cycle means of each referee quantity; block SDs of the mean over cycles 20-1020 for blocks of 50, 100, 200, 250, 500 cycles; integrated autocorrelation time (Sokal window, per-cycle series; period-two quantities give small or negative values); drift of the cycles 20-120 mean against the 520-1020 mean in units of the 100-cycle block SD; pooled over seeds per condition and width (grand: blocks about the grand mean, so including seed-to-seed offsets; within: about each seed's own mean). Drift flags: referee/bulk.py measure applied to all ten 100-cycle blocks of each run. Scripts: sequel-data/runs/tools/e0027_blocks.py and e0027_flags.py (run from the sequel root).

summary.within_run_correlation: Integrated autocorrelation times of thickness, kinetic energies and temperatures are 5 to 13 cycles at L = 400 (one 42) against 4 to 8 at L = 100 (one 23); well under a 100-cycle block. Within-seed block SD scaled to 100 cycles does not grow from 100 to 250-cycle blocks (ratio 0.96 to 1.08 at L = 400 shallow; 0.98 to 1.29 at L = 400 deep, 3 seeds; 0.78 to 1.30 at L = 100).
summary.between_seed: At L = 400, Gamma 3.5 f* 0.3 depth 5, the 1000-cycle means of thickness, both kinetic energies and both temperatures differ between the five seeds by 2.04 to 2.26 times what the within-run 100-cycle block SD predicts (zcm 1.17, plate contact 0.86); at L = 100 0.70 to 1.50. At L = 400 deep (3 seeds) 0.84 to 1.36. The seed offsets are not explained by the final pattern mode (four of five seeds end with 14 wavelengths; the 15-wavelength seed is mid-range).
summary.drift_flags: The referee's drift test flags 70 of 315 quantity-blocks (22%) in cycles 520-1020 at L = 400 and 75 of 350 (21%) at L = 100; first blocks (cycles 20-120) 18 of 63 (29%) and 17 of 70 (24%). The flag rate is the same late as early and at both widths, so the flags in E0024 reflect the trend test's treatment of autocorrelated per-period means (flags come in correlated groups), not layers still settling at cycle 20.
summary.running_mean_drift: Cycles 20-120 mean minus cycles 520-1020 mean, in 100-cycle block SDs: within +/-2.4 in every run and quantity (the null SD of this difference is about 1.1).
